title: Decretal
summary: DECRETAL, noun 1. A letter of the pope, determining some point or question in ecclesiastical law. The decretals form the second part of the canon law. 2. A book of decrees, or edicts; a body of laws.

inlines.v: DECRETAL, noun 1. A letter of the pope, determining some point or question in ecclesiastical law. The decretals form the second part of the canon law. 2. A book of decrees, or edicts; a body of laws. 3. A collection of the popes decrees.
